Class IkeServiceBootstrap

java.lang.Object
network.ike.knowledge.spi.IkeServiceBootstrap
public final class IkeServiceBootstrap extends Object
The generic forked-JVM entry point: resolves a knowledge service from the fork's classpath, materializes the typed request from a properties file, executes, and writes the typed result as a properties file. One bootstrap serves every service — the KnowledgeService codec bridge keeps it free of per-service knowledge.

Arguments: <serviceInterface> <requestFile> <resultFile>. The request file may carry the reserved top-level key implementation naming the implementation's simple class name when the classpath provides several.

Failure is signalled by throwing — the JVM exits non-zero and the invoking goal fails the build. Nothing here (and nothing in a well-behaved implementation) calls System.exit.

Resolution uses the context class loader — the java -cp fork this bootstrap is designed for. A module-path fork would additionally need the service bindings visible to the boot layer.
